routes.label: Custom packaging quote checklist
routes.reason: Helps small business buyers prepare the details needed before asking for custom packaging review.

routes.label: Product overview
routes.reason: Use this route to match order needs to paper boxes, mailer boxes, rigid gift boxes, paper tubes, paper bags or clear boxes.

routes.label: Contact / RFQ intake
routes.reason: Use when the buyer can share product type, dimensions, quantity range, packaging goal, artwork status and target market.

decisions: Clarify whether the order is for launch packaging, e-commerce shipping, retail presentation, gift sets or repeat replenishment.
Prepare product type, dimensions, quantity range, material direction, print coverage, artwork status and target market before RFQ.
Do not assume fixed MOQ, fixed lead time or lowest price; supplier review depends on structure, quantity and production details.
